first_reading_independence.statement: The image assessments below were written without reading root-observations.json or root's current candidate interpretations. Prior work on these same held copies was known, so this is not blind.

coverage.display_method: view_image(detail='original') on every listed file, displayed without new crops, resizing, overlays, or derived images.
coverage.not_inspected_here: The other 22 early samples, unsampled early frames, other C frames, pixel registration overlays, root candidate notes, audio, or historical source media beyond the listed unchanged PNGs. Earlier reviews are not counted as current image coverage.

stationary_scene_observation: Both groups show the same distinctive arrangement: the dark foreground tower on the right, the pale narrow foreground building left of center, lower rooftop blocks and street, and the striped background building where visible. The first C shot and early copy have broadly comparable wide framing; the third C shot is appreciably tighter and differently framed. This supports a common scene/viewpoint family but does not alone identify a frame or establish recording reuse.

early_image_observations.observation: Wide scene with relatively compact lower cloud above the striped building; the later pronounced forward cloud around the street is not yet as developed.
Dark rounded upper-left cloud and a sloping, scalloped bright right edge over the striped building. A plausible cloud-detail candidate for the first C reference.
Similar wide framing and distinctive upper dark lobe/sloping bright cloud edge; the cloud contour resembles C local 0 beyond merely matching buildings.
Billowed lower/right cloud edge is more developed; the outline and internal dark/bright arrangement resemble C local 2.
Upper dark cloud and scalloped front persist, with more developed forward cloud. A plausible changing-detail alternative for C local 4, not an exact-frame finding.

Visibly soft/blurred image with more prominent forward cloud curling around the lower street/rooftops. This resembles the advanced foreground cloud in C local 4, but differs from the less advanced lower cloud of C local 0.

Wider/downward view exposes more foreground street/trees; a bright-edged cloud tongue is behind the center rooftops. Buildings agree with the close-up scene, but their agreement does not resolve its cloud stage.

Cloud has a rounded forward wall behind the pale building and center rooftop block. The static winner recurring for later C references cannot itself mean those distinct references share this exact frame.
Similar stationary composition; the cloud wall is farther developed than in the first C-shot references. Its high static rank for C local 4 does not supply matching changing detail there.
Broad scalloped cloud ridge behind the pale foreground building, with a lower front near the center rooftop block. General later-stage scene agreement; no unique C local 14 correspondence resolved.
Broad lobed front and upper cloud column; a plausible C local 14 cloud-stage candidate, but I cannot confidently pair distinctive fine outlines one-to-one across the framing/resolution difference.
Cloud fills more of the central background and curls forward around the pale building/rooftop group. General later-stage agreement, not a resolved C local 19 instant.
Larger lobed cloud wall with a forward low roll near the center rooftop. A changing-detail candidate for C local 19; exact outline agreement is not secure at this resolution.

Reframed scene with prominent upper cloud lobes and a lower rounded front, broadly resembling C local 19. A bright vertical streak is also visible in the early image sky; its origin and correspondence are not established.
Cloud has advanced around/behind the pale foreground building and central rooftop, with a more developed low front. A plausible later-stage candidate for C local 24.
More advanced lobed cloud front near the street and rooftop group; rounded dark/bright folds broadly resemble C local 24. Fine contours and exact-frame identity remain unresolved.

reference_assessments.static: Same stationary scene arrangement, but C is a substantially tighter and differently framed view.
reference_assessments.changing_detail: A large bright-edged cloud wall behind the pale building and next to the dark tower appears in both; the shortlisted early frames show different configurations of this developing wall.
reference_assessments.contrary_or_ambiguous: I cannot securely identify the particular C ridge/lobes one-to-one in these small early images. The dynamic leader's score is only a ranking within the declared model, not visual authentication. Earlier/later cloud stages and another nearby camera remain live alternatives.
reference_assessments.classification: Stationary-scene agreement and a tentative cloud-stage lead; discriminating exact changing-detail correspondence unresolved.

reference_assessments.static: Shared buildings/rooftops are clear; framing and brightness differ.
reference_assessments.changing_detail: 900/960 have a broad upper cloud mass and rounded forward roll resembling C's cloud configuration more than the early 570 stage does.
reference_assessments.contrary_or_ambiguous: The fine folded outlines cannot be matched confidently point-for-point. 570's static lead is not a time match; 900/960 remain alternatives, and 960 has a distinct bright sky streak whose origin is unknown.
reference_assessments.classification: Plausible later cloud-detail candidates; weaker than the first-shot comparison and not exact-frame identity.

reference_assessments.static: The stationary buildings agree in both earlier and later candidates.
reference_assessments.changing_detail: 1079/1109 better resemble the advanced cloud wall and lower front around the pale building and center rooftop than 570/630.
reference_assessments.contrary_or_ambiguous: C is much brighter/tighter and the low-resolution early frames do not resolve every contour. The last sampled early frame being best ranked does not locate the true optimum or bound its time; it is an endpoint of this finite sampled set.
reference_assessments.classification: Plausible later cloud-detail candidates, exact correspondence unresolved.

ordering.observation: The predeclared primary dynamic leaders increase within each C shot. This order is recorded as returned, not selected from convenient alternatives.
ordering.ambiguity: Static winners repeat and competing shortlists overlap. Near-best dynamic alternatives for the first shot overlap too, so an ordered best-ranked path does not eliminate reordered or repeated assignments. No alternative path was selected to enforce order.
ordering.limit: This supports candidate sequence leads, especially for the first shot, not continuous timing, playback rate, original capture continuity, or a bridge over either C montage cut or the earlier 175/176 discontinuity. No rate or offset was fitted.

conclusion.first_shot: Distinctive cloud-detail resemblance plus shared scenery supports a substantially stronger picture-correspondence lead than skyline alone. The three references plausibly belong to the same evolving scene sequence represented by nearby early-copy samples. Exact exposures and a continuous temporal map are not established.
conclusion.third_shot: The same stationary scene is clear and later cloud-stage candidates are plausible, but changing-detail identification is less secure. C local 14 is the weakest of the six references; I would not label the third-shot sequence frame-identified from this review.
conclusion.strongest_alternative: Nearby times and possibly a nearby camera can share the same scenery and broadly evolving cloud; processing, crop, aspect normalization and the early copy's low resolution can make broad cloud structures score well without a unique exposure match. The numerical choice among sampled candidates is not a calibrated identity probability.
conclusion.disconfirming_detail: High static candidates can have visibly different cloud development, notably 480 for C local 0, 630 for C local 4, and the recurring 570/630 candidates for much later C references.
conclusion.what_would_change_weight: A separately authorized dense visual check demonstrating a sequence of distinctive local cloud contours under a fixed, adequate geometric model, while retaining contradictory and ambiguous candidates, would strengthen frame/sequence identification. This review neither performs nor authorizes that extension.
conclusion.prohibited_inferences: No sound authentication or absence, physical trajectory, historical cause ranking, ownership attribution, original-source custody, independent historical corroboration, scientific acceptance, or legal finding.

image_identity_check.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, hashlib, struct
p=pathlib.Path("/Users/admin/docs/911-worktrees/sherlock-wtc7-investigation/research/sherlock-wtc7-investigation/audio-listening-2026-10-05/c-source-lineage/picture-correspondence")
a=json.loads((p/'picture01/input-map.json').read_text())
r=json.loads((p/'picture01/rankings.json').read_text())
expected=[300,360,390,420,450,480,510,570,630,690,720,870,900,960,1079,1109]
actual=sorted({i for x in r.values() for i in x['shortlist_union']})
assert actual==expected
assert [x['source_index'] for x in a['references']]==[12900,12960,13020,13320,13470,13620]
checked=[]
for kind, rows, root, dims in [('early',[x for x in a['early'] if x['source_index'] in expected],pathlib.Path(a['early_map']).parent,(320,224)),('C',a['references'],pathlib.Path(a['c_map']).parent,(1280,720))]:
 for row in rows:
  f=root/row['png']; b=f.read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
  assert len(b)==row['bytes']
  assert b[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
  assert struct.unpack('>II',b[16:24])==dims
  checked.append({'kind':kind,'source_index':row['source_index'],'path':str(f),'sha256':row['sha256'],'dimensions':dims})
assert len(checked)==22
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','shortlist_union':actual,'images_checked':len(checked),'checks':'22 file SHA-256, byte lengths, PNG signatures and native dimensions; exact 16-candidate union and six-reference indices','checked':checked,'dynamic_winner_indices_in_C_reference_order':[x['dynamic']['top_two'][0] for x in r.values()],'static_winner_indices_in_C_reference_order':[x['static']['top_two'][0] for x in r.values()],'limitation':'No pixel extraction or historical numerical score recomputation in this visual review.'},indent=2))
PY
